_comment: QA Nov 15 evening (chars-locomotion): "Render proper gun models for them." One service pistol for the guards and enforcers, attached to hand_r by ACastMember (Armed). Raw mesh, low poly: it is small on screen.
style: 1940s American period piece, realistic proportions, single object, centred, matte, neutral flat lighting, no baked shadows, no text, no logos, plain background

props.guns_pistol: a 1940s M1911 style semi-automatic service pistol handgun seen whole: a straight blued dark gunmetal steel slide with fine rear serrations, a short barrel, a curved trigger inside a round trigger guard, a hammer at the back, a slightly angled grip with checkered dark walnut wood grip panels, a magazine base at the bottom of the grip, a real-size handgun, nothing else
